title: Enhance Metric Description Availability for Multiple Categories (APM, RUM, Log, NetRoute, Flow)
description_summary: Today metric descriptions show only for the 'Metric' category when creating a widget. Extend descriptions to APM, RUM, Log, NetRoute, Flow. On the widget-creation screen, selecting a metric in the Metric dropdown must surface a description pop-up explaining what the metric measures / how to read it. Descriptions are mapped from each category's data source and must be consistent in format. If a description is missing, the UI must inform the user it is unavailable for that metric.

acceptance_criteria.then: When creating a widget, descriptions are available for categories APM, RUM, Log, NetRoute, Flow (previously Metric only)
acceptance_criteria.source_text: descriptions must be available for the following categories: APM, RUM, Log, NetRoute, Flow

acceptance_criteria.then: Each description conveys relevant info: what the metric measures, how values are interpreted, potential root cause of anomalies
acceptance_criteria.source_text: Descriptions should display relevant information ... what the metric measures, how values are interpreted, and the potential root cause of anomalies

acceptance_criteria.then: The widget creation interface displays a description pop-up for each metric in the above categories
acceptance_criteria.source_text: The widget creation interface should display a description pop-up for each metric

acceptance_criteria.then: Description is visible upon selecting a metric within the 'Metric' dropdown
acceptance_criteria.source_text: Descriptions should be visible upon selecting a metric within the 'Metric' dropdown

acceptance_criteria.then: Descriptions are correctly mapped from the respective data sources and displayed consistently per category
acceptance_criteria.source_text: Descriptions must be correctly mapped from the respective data sources and displayed consistently for each category

acceptance_criteria.then: Descriptions across categories keep a consistent format and structure
acceptance_criteria.source_text: Descriptions across different categories should maintain a consistent format and structure for clarity

acceptance_criteria.then: If description data is missing for a metric, the UI informs the user the description is unavailable for that specific metric
acceptance_criteria.source_text: If the description data for any category is missing, informing the user that the description is unavailable for that specific metric
